description.cn:
3件套组效果：装备者敏捷<@ba.vup>+{agi_up}</>。
当装备者生命值高于{hp_ratio:0%}时，造成的<@ba.pd>物理伤害</><@ba.vup>+{phy_dmg_up:0%}</>。
description.en:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Agility <@ba.vup>+{agi_up}</>. 
When the wearer's HP is above {hp_ratio:0%}, <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> <@ba.vup>+{phy_dmg_up:0%}</>.

description.cn:
3件套组效果：装备者所有技能伤害<@ba.vup>+{dmg_up:0%}</>。
当装备者施放战技、连携技、终结技时，分别<@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0%}</>攻击力，持续{duration}秒。三种增益状态独立存在，层数无法叠加。
description.en:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Skill DMG <@ba.vup>+{dmg_up:0%}</>. 
When the wearer casts a battle skill, combo skill, or ultimate, the wearer gains ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0%}</> for {duration}s. The buff from each of the three skill types is unique and does not stack with itself.

description.cn:
3件套组效果：装备者攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0%}</>。
当小队内任意干员施放战技时，装备者获得一层<@ba.key>应龙之锐</>，使得该干员下一次连携技伤害<@ba.vup>+{dmg_up:0%}</>，<@ba.key>应龙之锐</>最多叠加{max_stack:0}层。
description.en:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0%}</>. 
When any operator in the team casts a battle skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of <@ba.key>Yinglung's Edge</> that gives DMG <@ba.vup>+{dmg_up:0%}</> to the wearer's next combo skill. <@ba.key>Yinglung's Edge</> can stack {max_stack:0} time(s).

description.cn:
3件套组效果：装备者攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0%}</>。
当装备者施放连携技时，获得一层<@ba.key>碾骨重压</>，下一次的战技伤害<@ba.vup>+{dmg_up:0%}</>，<@ba.key>碾骨重压</>最多可叠加{max_stack:0}层。
description.en:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0%}</>. 
When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of <@ba.key>Bonekrushing Smash</> that grants the wearer's next battle skill DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{dmg_up:0%}</>. <@ba.key>Bonekrushing Smash</> can stack {max_stack:0} time(s).

description.cn:
3件套组效果：装备者所有技能伤害<@ba.vup>+{skill_dmg_up:0%}</>。
装备者使敌人达到<@ba.key>{stack_cond}</>层及以上<#ba.spellinflict>法术附着</>后，造成的<@ba.key>法术伤害</><@ba.vup>+{spell_dmg_up:0%}</>，持续{duration}秒，该效果无法叠加。
description.en:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Skill DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{skill_dmg_up:0%}</>.
After the wearer applies <@ba.key>{stack_cond}</> or more stacks of <#ba.spellinflict>Arts Infliction</> on the enemy, the wearer gains <@ba.key>Arts DMG Dealt</> <@ba.vup>+{spell_dmg_up:0%}</> for {duration}s. This effect cannot stack.

description.cn:
3件套组效果：装备者连携技冷却缩减<@ba.vup>+{1-comboskill_cooldown:0%}</>。
当装备者施放连携技时，所有技能伤害<@ba.vup>+{spell_up:0%}</>，持续{duration}秒。该效果最多叠加{max_stack}层，每层单独计算持续时间。
description.en:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction <@ba.vup>+{1-comboskill_cooldown:0%}</>.
When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains Skill DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{spell_up:0%}</> (for every skill) for {duration}s. This effect can reach {max_stack} stacks. Duration of each stack is counted separately.

description.cn:
3件套组效果：装备者连携技冷却缩减<@ba.vup>+{1-comboskill_cooldown:0%}</>。
装备者通过技能恢复技力后，全队造成的伤害<@ba.vup>+{dmg_up:0%}</>，持续{duration}秒，该效果无法叠加。
description.en:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction <@ba.vup>+{1-comboskill_cooldown:0%}</>.
After the wearer's skill recovers SP, the team gains DMG <@ba.vup>+{dmg_up:0%}</> for {duration}s. This effect cannot stack.

description.cn:
3件套组效果：装备者源石技艺强度<@ba.vup>+{phy_spell_up:0}</>。
当装备者施加<#ba.conduct>导电</>后，<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</><@ba.vup>+{pulse_dmg_up:0%}</>，持续{duration}秒，该效果无法叠加；当装备者施加<#ba.frozen>冻结</>后，<@ba.cryst>寒冷伤害</><@ba.vup>+{cryst_dmg_up:0%}</>，持续{duration2}秒，该效果无法叠加。
description.en:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts Intensity <@ba.vup>+{phy_spell_up:0}</>. 
After the wearer applies <#ba.conduct>Electrification</>, the wearer gains <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</><@ba.vup> +{pulse_dmg_up:0%}</> for {duration}s. After the wearer applies <#ba.frozen>Solidification</>, the wearer gains <@ba.cryst>Cryo DMG</><@ba.vup> +{cryst_dmg_up:0%}</> for {duration2}s. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

description.cn:
3件套组效果：装备者暴击率<@ba.vup>+{crit_up:0%}</>。
当装备者触发暴击后，{duration}秒内<@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0%}</>攻击力，该效果最多叠加{max_stack:0}层。层数叠满后，额外<@ba.vup>+{crit_up2:0%}</>暴击率，该效果无法叠加。
description.en:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Critical Rate <@ba.vup>+{crit_up:0%}</>. 
After the wearer scores a critical hit, the wearer gains ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0%}</> for {duration}s. This effect can reach {max_stack:0} stacks. At max stacks, grant an additional Critical Rate <@ba.vup>+{crit_up2:0%}</>. This effect cannot stack.

description.cn:
3件套组效果：装备者攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0%}</>。
装备者每次<#ba.consume>消耗</><#ba.conduct>导电</>或<#ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>后，根据<#ba.statuslevel>异常等级</>获得相同层数的强化状态，每层使<@ba.pulse>电磁伤害</>和<@ba.natur>自然伤害</><@ba.vup>+{spell_dmg_up:0%}</>，持续{duration}秒。强化状态最多存在{max_stack}层，每层单独计算持续时间。
description.en:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0%}</>.
Whenever the wearer <#ba.consume>consumes</> <#ba.conduct>Electrification</> or <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</>, the wearer gains a number of buff stacks equal to the <#ba.statuslevel>Status Level</> of the Arts Reaction consumed, with each buff stack giving <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG Dealt</> and <@ba.natur>Nature DMG Dealt</> <@ba.vup>+{spell_dmg_up:0%}</> for {duration}s. The number of buff stacks maxes out at {max_stack} stacks. Duration of each stack is counted separately.

description.cn:
3件套组效果：装备者源石技艺强度<@ba.vup>+{phy_spell_up:0}</>。
当装备者施加<#ba.burning>燃烧</>后，<@ba.fire>灼热伤害</>+<@ba.vup>{fire_dmg_up:0%}</>，持续{duration}秒，该效果无法叠加；当装备者施加<#ba.corrupt>腐蚀</>后，<@ba.natur>自然伤害</>+<@ba.vup>{nature_dmg_up:0%}</>，持续{duration2}秒，该效果无法叠加。
description.en:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Arts Intensity <@ba.vup>+{phy_spell_up:0}</>. 
After the wearer applies <#ba.burning>Combustion</>, the wearer gains <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> +<@ba.vup>{fire_dmg_up:0%}</> for {duration}s. After the wearer applies <#ba.corrupt>Corrosion</>, the wearer gains <@ba.natur>Nature DMG</> +<@ba.vup>{nature_dmg_up:0%}</> for {duration2}s. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

description.cn:
3件套组效果：装备者治疗效率<@ba.vup>+{heal_up:0%}</>。
当装备者治疗我方目标后，使该目标在{duration}秒内受到的所有类型伤害<@ba.vup>-{1-dmg_taken_down:0%}</>；如果该目标受到的治疗量溢出，则受到的所有类型伤害<@ba.vup>-{1-dmg_taken_down2:0%}</>。上述效果无法叠加。
description.en:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's HP Treatment Efficiency <@ba.vup>+{heal_up:0%}</>. 
After the wearer gives HP treatment to an allied target, that target also gains <@ba.vup>{1-dmg_taken_down:0%}</> DMG Reduction against all types of DMG for {duration}s. If the said treatment exceeds the target's Max HP, the target gains <@ba.vup>{1-dmg_taken_down2:0%}</> DMG Reduction against all types of DMG. The aforementioned effects cannot stack.

description.cn:
3件套组效果：装备者失衡效率加成<@ba.vup>+{poise_up:0%}</>。
当装备者造成<#ba.physicalstatus>物理异常</>后，额外造成一次{atk_scale:0%}攻击力的物理伤害[<@ba.poise>{poise}</>点失衡值]。该效果每{duration}秒最多触发一次。
description.en:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's Stagger Efficiency Bonus <@ba.vup>+{poise_up:0%}</>.
After the wearer applies a <#ba.physicalstatus>Physical Status</>, the wearer also performs 1 hit that deals {atk_scale:0%} ATK of Physical DMG and [<@ba.poise>{poise}</> Stagger]. Effect trigger cooldown: {duration}s.

description.cn:
3件套组效果：装备者攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0%}</>。
装备者施加<#ba.noguard>破防</>后，<@ba.pd>物理伤害</><@ba.vup>+{phy_dmg_up:0%}</>，持续{duration}秒，最多可叠加{max_stack:0}层。若使目标达到{stack_cond:0}层<#ba.noguard>破防</>，物理伤害额外<@ba.vup>+{phy_dmg_up2:0%}</>，持续{duration2}秒，该效果无法叠加。
description.en:
3-piece set effect: Wearer's ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0%}</>. 
After the wearer applies <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</>, the wearer gains <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> <@ba.vup>+{phy_dmg_up:0%}</> for {duration}s. This effect can reach {max_stack:0} stacks. If the target already has {stack_cond:0} stack(s) of <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</>, the wearer gains an additional Physical DMG <@ba.vup>+{phy_dmg_up2:0%}</> for {duration2}s. This effect cannot stack.

description.cn:
装备者对敌人造成<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>时，获得攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0.0%}</>，持续{duration:0}秒。
若装备者为主控干员，攻击力提升的数值翻倍，且<#ba.lastcombo>重击</>对敌人造成的失衡值<@ba.vup>+{poise_up:0.0%}</>。
<@ba.info>同名效果无法叠加。</>
description.en:
When the wielder performs a <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> on the enemy, the wielder gains ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0.0%}</> for {duration:0}s.
If the wielder is also the controlled operator, double the ATK increase gained and buff the <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> so that it deals Stagger <@ba.vup>+{poise_up:0.0%}</> to the enemy.
<@ba.info>Effects of the same name cannot stack.</>

description.en:

<@ba.info>The two effects apply separately and do not stack with themselves.</>

ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0.0%}</>.

<@ba.info>Effects of the same name cannot stack.</>

description.cn:
攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0.0%}</>。
装备者造成暴击伤害后，获得1层<@ba.key>狼血</>，物理和灼热伤害<@ba.vup>+{dmg_up:0.0%}</>，最多叠加{max_stack:0}层。当<@ba.key>狼血</>叠加至{max_stack:0}层后，物理和灼热伤害额外<@ba.vup>+{dmg_up2:0.0%}</>，持续{duration:0}秒。持续时间结束后，清空所有<@ba.key>狼血</>叠加层数。
description.en:
ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk_up:0.0%}</>.
After the wielder's skill deals Critical DMG, the wielder gains 1 stack of <@ba.key>Wolven Blood</> that grants Physical and Heat DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{dmg_up:0.0%}</>. <@ba.key>Wolven Blood</> can reach {max_stack:0} stacks. After reaching {max_stack:0} stacks, the wielder gains another Physical and Heat DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{dmg_up2:0.0%}</> for {duration:0}s. After the duration ends, all <@ba.key>Wolven Blood</> stacks are removed.
